name: nopCommerce Connector
brief: Bidirectional integration between nopCommerce and Dynamics 365 Business Central (catalog selection & export, order and customer import).
description: Connects nopCommerce store(s) to Business Central, modeled after the Microsoft Shopify Connector. Business Central acts as the master/orchestrator: only explicitly selected items (per shop, via filters or individually) are pushed to nopCommerce. Orders and customers are imported from nopCommerce into Business Central and mapped.
